name: LegalRequestFrontDoor
tagline: One front door for every request to in-house legal – triaged, routed and on the clock.
description: A complete legal intake app in one Power Apps component: guided request form, risk triage scoring with explained reasons, automatic routing to legal teams with value-based escalation, first-response SLA clocks, queue, status board, workload and dashboard views. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages with built-in demo data.
features: Guided intake for 10 configurable legal request types
Risk triage 0–100 with reasons, suggested priority and team
Routing rules and escalation above a value threshold
SLA per priority with at-risk, breached and paused states
Status workflow with allowed transitions, required fields and undo
Bulk assign / priority / status, CSV export, grouping and filters
Phone layout with bottom view switcher
Power Fx outputs and events; Power Pages Web API control
